decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The marquee shall not be installed on the site before 20 April in any year; shall only be in use from 1st May to 30th September in each consecutive year; and shall be removed each year within one week of that dat; and this permission shall expire on 30th September 2013 when the use shall cease.  The site of the marquee shall be made good, levelled and laid to grass no later than one month after its removal for each yearly period, including 2013.  When the marquee is erected, each year, the green netting shall be positioned and permanently retained while the structure remains in place.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No excavations shall take place for the construction of, or for the purposes of the use of the marquee.

Condition : 5 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff do not enter the area of the nearby Site of Special Scientific interest.

Condition : 6 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquees, the organisers shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff cars associated with the use parked in no place other than the main public car park or in the Lime Avenue car parking area (using the latter only in the event that the main public car park is already full) or the designated disabled persons' parking spaces shown on the plans hereby approved and shall ensure that these car parking areas are shown in the submitted application are available exclusively to visitors and staff at the event.
Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted for a temporary marquee purpose shall not be carried on outside the following times 10am to 11.30pm on all days except Sundays when events will end at 11pm.
Condition : 8 - No firework displays shall take place in conjunction with any event held in or adjoining the Marquees hereby approved.

Condition : 9 - Before the marquee is first used, each year, a sound limiter (environmental noise control system) shall be installed in accordance with details that shall be first submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to control noise levels.  The sound limiter system (or at least the power amplifier(s)) are to be permanently installed at the venue, maintained in an operational state and kept switched on at all times whem amplification is used  and no sound checks shall be carried out outside the permitted hours of use, and no other form of amplification.
Condition : 10 - All refuse shall be removed from Syon Park site after each function has finished and disposed of to appropriate refuse storage recylcing facilities.
description: Erection of a temporary marquee for five years for daytime and evening private/corporate events from 1st May to 30th September for each year period for 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, and 2013.
